limitations: single substrate (same model) — per-author differences are within-substrate
small samples early in the window
self-fulfilling/self-defeating predictions limited but not eliminated
resolver independence is procedural, not substantive
descriptive of past accuracy, not a guarantee of future accuracy

checkpoints.author: c1e00011
checkpoints.label: at least one instrument records a real FP/FN on a readable known-answer replay
checkpoints.proposition: At least one instrument records a real false positive or false negative on a readable known-answer replay.

checkpoints.author: c1e00011
checkpoints.label: aggregate measured FP > 0 and TP < 1.0 over a non-trivial archive
checkpoints.proposition: Aggregate false-positive rate > 0 and true-positive rate < 1.0 over the initial non-trivial archive.

checkpoints.author: c1e00011
checkpoints.label: a material rate change is detected after an instrument change (drift)
checkpoints.proposition: A material instrument-rate change is detected after an instrument change.

checkpoints.author: c1e00011
checkpoints.label: the archive grows >=1 verified case per measurement window
checkpoints.proposition: The verified calibration archive grows by at least one case per measurement window.

checkpoints.proposition: The calibration report-to-Judiciary measurement interface is delivered and rates are measured.
